title: Lovable pricing: billing basis and cost boundaries
summary: Lovable pricing: billing basis and cost boundaries. Separate the recorded base price from unverified usage and operating costs.

sections.heading: Monthly versus annual commitment
paragraphs: The recorded annual amount is a total commitment, not a monthly invoice. Compare the same allowance and cancellation terms before deciding whether the annual commitment is appropriate for a prototype.

sections.heading: After the prototype launches
paragraphs: Measure both editing and live-application usage. A quiet month of development can still have database, network or AI-feature demand. Do not assume the subscription alone is the lifetime cost of the app.

sections.heading: No task-to-credit exchange rate
paragraphs: A request, a credit and a token are not interchangeable. ToolPilot has not measured a representative workload across these products, so this guide does not invent a shared usage conversion or promise a fixed number of completed tasks.

verdict: Separate the subscription commitment from how the workspace consumes credits.
bestFor: Buyers checking Lovable subscription and usage assumptions
notFor: Readers seeking a guaranteed workload total without measuring usage
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.

pros.text: Lovable’s plan documentation separates subscription credits from daily build credits and monthly Cloud and AI grants.
The usage page breaks activity into Build and Run credits and provides project-level usage views for review.

cons.text: Run credits can include Cloud, AI gateway and connector usage, so the plan amount alone does not describe the full deployed-app cost.
Credit availability and behavior vary by plan and credit type; avoid converting a credit allowance into a fixed number of completed features.

faqs.question: Do Lovable credits cover only building the app?
faqs.answer: No. The usage documentation distinguishes Build credits from Run credits, including Cloud, AI gateway and connector activity.

faqs.question: How should I estimate a monthly Lovable budget?
faqs.answer: Record the plan and its included credits, then measure representative build and runtime activity in the workspace usage view; price infrastructure and connected services separately.

faqs.question: Does the model-training setting depend on a paid credit plan?
faqs.answer: Lovable's 2026-09-15 Privacy Policy says users can opt out in account settings on any plan at no cost, with prospective effect. Its Terms, Security page and older Business/Enterprise DPA describe different data classes and scopes, so verify the actual workspace agreement and setting separately from the credit budget.
